title: Client trajectory exec slides and adoption checklist
summary: Two variant slide templates (Standard + Enterprise) for a customer-facing quarterly review plus an internal renewal tracker and action checklist. Draft includes slide-by-slide speaker notes, suggested metrics, risk scoring rubric, and canned email outreach sequences for each renewal stage.
audience: Customer Success Managers, Renewal Leads, Solutions Engineers, Account Execs
purpose: Provide a compact, repeatable QBR presentation and a lightweight renewal orchestration checklist that scales from SMB-style standard accounts to deep-enterprise engagements requiring legal/compliance touchpoints.
approach_overview: Keep the customer deck <20 slides for standard accounts; 25-35 slides modular for enterprise. Emphasize outcomes first, then adoption signals and next-step commitments. Use a two-column slide pattern: left = outcome/metric, right = recommended action or ask.
standard_template_slide_list: Executive snapshot: ARR / usage / ROI headline - 1 slide
Adoption highlights: top features used & power users - 1 slide
Health metrics: usage trends, errors, latency (red/yellow/green) - 1 slide
Open technical blockers & recent fixes - 1 slide
Top wins since last QBR - 1 slide
Customer success story / quote / quick reference - 1 slide
Renewal timeline & recommended next steps - 1 slide
enterprise_template_slide_list: Title, attendees, and meeting objective (5 min) - 1 slide
Executive summary: business impact & contract snapshot - 1 slide
Strategic context: how Redwood fits into customer roadmap - 1 slide
Detailed usage economics: tokens, per-feature cost breakdown, anomaly analysis - 1 slide
SLO/SLA performance: latency percentiles, error rates, incident summary - 1 slide
Adoption deep dive: team-level adoption, models/pipelines in production - 2 slides
Security & compliance posture: audit events, KMS/HSM status - 1 slide
Integrations & infra notes: VPC, Private deployment items - 1 slide
Risk & dependency map: third-party risks, single points of failure - 1 slide
Renewal & commercial options: committed capacity vs burst, recommended path - 1 slide
Detailed mutual action plan with owners & dates (90/180 day) - 2 slides
Appendix: telemetry links, dashboards, open tickets - multiple slides optional
speaker_notes_examples:
Title slide: quick intro, thank attendees, state top 2 outcomes you want from this meeting (e.g., alignment on renewal path, sign-off on batch plan).
Executive snapshot: lead with ROI headline ("Saved X% on model infra, Y% latency improvement") then call out one supporting chart. Keep slides visual not data-dense.
Adoption highlights: call out 3 behaviors you want to encourage and 1 friction to remove.
Ask slide: be explicit — pricing option A (commit), B (burst), C (trial increment) and recommended next step + timeline.
recommended_metrics: Monthly tokens (LM inference) - broken down by model family
Cost per 1k tokens normalized to model and quantization
Model quality signals: user satisfaction sampling, eval regressions
risk_scoring_rubric: Score each account 1-5 on three axes: Usage momentum (adoption growth), Technical stability (SRE incidents, error rates), Commercial engagement (executive touchpoints, procurement progress). Aggregate into R/Y/G band: 12-15 = Green, 7-11 = Yellow, <=6 = Red. Provide one prioritized mitigation action per low-scoring axis.
renewal_tracker_table_text:
Columns: Account | Renewal date | ARR | Current commit | Recommended commit | Risk band | Primary owner | Legal block? (Y/N) | Next milestone | Last outreach date | Notes.
Row sample: Acme Retail | 2026-03-15 | $220k | 8 GPUs reserved | 12 GPUs reserved (recommended) | Yellow | Priya Nair | Contract redline: data residency clause | Exec sync 2026-02-10 | 2026-01-20 | Waiting for security attestation
action_checklist_standard: Prep: pre-read with 2 slides (ROI + top 3 asks)
Pre-call: confirm attendees from both sides, add legal/IT if enterprise
During call: close on decision owner and timeline
Post-call: send mutual action plan within 48 hours
Within 2 weeks: follow-up on any legal/compliance docs
action_checklist_enterprise: Schedule technical deep-dive workshop for integration owners
Provide security packet and KMS/HSM diagrams
Offer capacity modeling session with infra team
Lock SLA targets and escalation path in writing
Run procurement timeline against renewal calendar
email_templates:
Pre-read send (subject): QBR pre-read & agenda — top outcomes we’ll review
Body: Hi <Name>, attaching a 2-slide pre-read: 1) ROI snapshot, 2) recommended next step. Can you confirm attendees? Looking to secure alignment on renewal options. Thanks, <CSM>

Post-QBR follow-up (subject): QBR notes & mutual action plan
Body: Hi <Name>, thanks for joining. Attached is the mutual action plan with owners and dates. Next milestone: Decision owner to confirm preferred commercial path by <date>. Let me know if you want a legal touchpoint scheduled.

Escalation (subject): Requesting executive alignment on renewal timing
Body: Hi <ExecName>, your team recommended we reach out to align on renewal timing. Current risk band: Yellow. Short ask: 15-minute sync next week to confirm top-level commercial direction.
examples_and_snippets:
Demo snippet: show a 30-second recording of an in-product workflow that reduced human review time from 8 min -> 2 min; include before/after metrics.
Customer quote snippet: "Redwood reduced our inference spend while improving response times for customer-facing chatflows."
Legal snippet to surface: data residency appendix required for EMEA financial customers — attach a one-pager.
notes_and_todos:
- Add direct link to the customer’s Console usage dashboard in appendix.
- Create a one-pager variant for small renewal (<$25k ARR) that removes legal/compliance slides.
- Build an internal Notion checklist for CSMs to run through 7 days before QBR.
- Experiment: A/B test opening with ROI vs opening with customer story for 20 accounts to see which leads to faster renewals.
privacy_and_compliance_tips: For enterprise decks include a redacted telemetry screenshot if necessary; never include PII in slides. When sharing audit logs with customers, remove hostnames and internal ticket ids unless agreed.
